text: Cool. I really like this pan cause I love end piece brownies. This is just a little smaller than a regular 9 by 12 pan but that's good because then I can bake my brownies in my toaster oven. I also love the fact that once the batter is in, I can add Different things to each brownie. product_metadata.title: Good Dee's Brownie Pan with Dividers, Non Stick Baking Pan Sets, Carbon Steel Bakeware Tray with Grips for Oven Baking, 18 Pre-Cut Square Molds for Brownies (12'' X 8'' X 2'')
features: BROWNIE TIME - Good Dee's Kitchen Brownie pan is made of high-carbon steel material which can transfer heat faster. What does this mean? It provides even heat distribution so all the brownies come out cooked evenly.

EQUAL PIECES - Want to have even sized brownies? The size of each part is 2 inches by 2.6 inches. The best part is the metal divider that cuts it for you while baking. No more knife cutting with lost brownie batter on each cut.

CUSTOMIZE TIME- Good Dee's loves OPTIONS. Do you love nuts but your kid, not so much? Well, you can now customize each one since it is pre cut. You can add candy, nuts, coconut flakes-and have an array of options. Just lift the divider after you bake the brownies and Voila.

SAVE TIME - When you're baking our newest soft baked brownies-which is a 1 lb bag! You can get 18 pre sliced brownies with a simple lift of the divider. Please use oven mitts as it is very hot once out of the oven. And as always, wait til it cools.

100% NON-STICK TECHNOLOGY - FREE OF BPA/PTFE/PFOA/PFOS, Lead & Cadmium! This Good Dee's pan is non stick, non-corrosive, stain-resistant; Corner brownies for everyone! Easy to clean up and even easier to make.

details.Specific Uses For Product: Great for Brownies, Lasagna, Cake, and so much more!
